additional: As a Finance Business Partner, you will be a key contributor to financial transformation and support the company's growth and profitability objectives. Reporting to the Finance Business Partner Manager, you will work closely with the Finance team and cross-functional stakeholders, with strong exposure to the business, to support performance analysis, forecasting and decision-making. You will manage financial performance across the global marketplace, focusing on both financial performance and operational costs (e.g. customer compensation costs, reimbursements). The role requires strong analytical skills, a genuine interest in how the business operates, and the ability to connect financial, accounting, and operational perspectives.
description:
Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry, connecting customers in over 190 countries with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands and charming boutiques from around the world. Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. 

 

FINANCE 

The Finance team stands as a strategic pillar of our organization, enabling the delivery of our business and financial goals, ensuring robust financial controls and optimizing overall financial performance. Finance is responsible for managing capital, ensuring financial integrity, optimizing resource allocation, and delivering accurate reporting to drive sustainable growth and profitability.

 

PORTO

Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals. 

 

THE ROLE

Reporting to the Accounting Manager, you will guide the required process and policy amendments that are necessary for prompt, worldwide, and smooth execution of the standards. You will have an important role in the accountancy of our company, working together with the team to achieve the goals for the monthly closing.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Prepare and post accounting entries with accuracy and timeliness

  • Support the month-end and year-end close activities

  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and investigate reconciling items under supervision

  • Assist with the preparation of tax returns and other statutory reporting requirements

  • Support the preparation of documentation for internal and external audits

  • Perform accounting controls and SOX activities in accordance with established procedures

  • Process and analyse accounting data, ensuring completeness and accuracy

  • Assist in identifying and resolving accounting discrepancies

  • Maintain accurate accounting records and supporting documentation

  • Contribute to process improvements and standardisation initiatives within the Accounting team

  • Collaborate with other Finance teams and business stakeholders to resolve accounting queries

WHO YOU ARE

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field

  • 3-5 years of experience in Accounting or Financial Reporting

  • Basic understanding of accounting principles; knowledge of IFRS is a plus

  • Strong Excel skills; experience with ERP systems is an advantage

  • Experience with SOX controls is a plus

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

  • Proactive, organised, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment

  • Good communication and teamwork skills

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

REWARDS & BENEFITS

  • Health insurance for the whole family and other well-being resources

  • 25 Days of Annual Leave (above the statutory) and additional Caring Days (2 days per year) and

  • Boomerang: sabbatical program after 5 years service

  • Training opportunities and free access to LinkedIn Learning

  • Flexible benefits program

  • Flexible working environment

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES STATEMENT & SCAM DISCLAIMER

  • EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES- Farfetch is an equal opportunities employer ensuring that all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.  We are determined that no applicant experiences discrimination on the basis of sex, race, ethnicity, religion or belief, disability, age, gender identity, ancestry, sexual orientation, veteran status, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. 

  • SCAM DISCLAIMER- It has come to our attention that there may be fraudulent activities involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent Farfetch in order to attract candidates to a SCAM. Please be aware that Farfetch does not conduct recruitment processes through messaging apps or any unofficial communication channels, other than our official careers website. Additionally, Farfetch will never ask candidates for any form of payment during the recruitment process.

description:
Stadium Goods is the premier global marketplace for authentic sneakers, streetwear, and collectibles. We sit at the intersection of retail, technology, and culture, empowering a massive community of buyers and sellers. Our digital ecosystem is the optimized interface that unlocks our core supply, driving sales across our flagship site, mobile app, and integrated global marketplaces.

We are a data-driven, fast-paced team that thrives on innovation and operational excellence. By mastering the full Shopify ecosystem—from the front-end user experience to the complex data flow connecting channels like Tapcart, TikTok, and Walmart—we ensure a seamless, world-class experience for our customers worldwide. Join us to own a critical piece of our technology stack and drive significant growth in a thriving, dynamic industry.

THE ROLE
You will be responsible for cultivating and developing relationships with our most valuable suppliers to contribute to Partner Success supply goals. You’ll support a diverse base of suppliers, helping them grow their quarterly volume and engagement with the Pro Seller Program. You’ll develop a unique skillset as you engage and drive supplier loyalty through various engagement and business development activities in collaboration with cross-functional teams, ensuring a seamless, exceptional consignment experience.

lists.content:
• Serve as a resource for all Pro Seller Level 3 Suppliers, ensuring all offered benefits are achieved while providing a luxury experience and unparalleled service.

  • Achieve personal supply targets and related KPIs.

  • Create and send personalized communications to clients, informing them of product insights, commission promotions, accepted brands, and other Stadium Goods news relevant to their interests.

  • Support inventory management activities for your consignor base, overseeing their end-to-end consignment experience.

  • Support the Partner Success team with ad-hoc supply activities.

  • Work quickly and diligently to resolve managed account issues as necessary.

  • Work closely with Partner Success Management on individual monthly, quarterly, and annual inventory planning activities, tracking results against expectations on a weekly and monthly basis, and identifying new business opportunities.

  • Collaborate closely with colleagues across the Account Management team and with cross-functional teams such as Marketing, Commercial, CS, and Catalog.

  • Attend events as required to aid business development and act as a Stadium Goods brand ambassador.

• You are an experienced professional with a proven track record in account management, customer success, relationship management, or similar client-facing roles.

  • You possess a solid understanding of the streetwear and sneaker market, with the ability to offer insights on current and emerging trends.

  • You are passionate about creating customer value and delivering an elevated, personalized client experience.

  • You are a collaborative team member, capable of working effectively with local, remote, and cross-functional teams.

  • You are an excellent relationship builder, adept at actively listening to supplier needs, influencing stakeholders, and incorporating constructive feedback.

  • You are a hands-on problem solver, able to translate complex ideas and business needs into clear, actionable plans for internal and external stakeholders through effective communication.

  • You are skilled at interacting with various levels of the organization and across diverse global cross-functional teams.

  • You have a growth mindset and the ability to identify opportunities to expand supplier relationships, increase supply, and drive long-term business growth.

• STADIUM GOODS is an equal opportunities employer ensuring that all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process. We are determined that no applicant experiences discrimination on the basis of sex, race, ethnicity, religion or belief, disability, age, gender identity, ancestry, sexual orientation, veteran status, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. We continue to build our consciously inclusive culture as part of our strategy throughout our business, partnerships and communities.

Please be aware that Farfetch does not conduct recruitment processes through messaging apps or any unofficial communication channels, other than our official careers website. Additionally, Farfetch will never ask candidates for any form of payment during the recruitment process.

• The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $60,000 and $67,000/[YEAR]; however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.
  • If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

THE ROLE

The Associate Project Manager - Privacy will join the Farfetch Legal, Ethics & Compliance Team, with the aim of assisting the Legal Privacy Team in ensuring that the FARFETCH Group complies with the data protection standards applicable worldwide, implementing and improving procedures to demonstrate accountability of the Group around privacy and security issues.

lists.content:
Drive Impact Across the Business

  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional privacy initiatives, aligning teams and ensuring smooth execution from planning to delivery
  • Partner with stakeholders across Legal, Security, Product, and Business teams to bring initiatives to life
  • Own multiple projects simultaneously, balancing priorities while proactively identifying and mitigating risks

    • Shape Our Privacy Program

  • Help design and implement a scalable, forward-thinking data privacy framework
  • Maintain and evolve records of processing activities across the group, working closely with business owners
  • Support and guide teams through Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), collaborating with Legal, Security, and the Data Protection Officer (DPO)
  • Ensure Privacy Policies and related frameworks stay up to date through structured review cycles

    • Turn Data into Insights

  • Define and track KPIs to measure the success and maturity of the privacy program
  • Build dashboards and reports with the DPO to provide clear visibility on initiatives and risks
  • Communicate progress, insights, and outcomes to stakeholders and senior leadership in a clear and compelling way

    • Enable Efficient Operations

  • Support the management of Data Subject Rights Requests (DSRRs)
  • Leverage privacy tools (e.g., OneTrust or similar platforms) to streamline processes and improve efficiency
  • Manage and oversee the Brightflag legal operations platform system, including handling legal financial operations, reviewing and processing invoices, ensuring billing accuracy, and supporting cost control and reporting for the legal department.

• You have a degree in Management, IT, or a related field
  • Experienced in project management, delivery, or similar roles
  • Experience or exposure to privacy, data protection, or cybersecurity is a plus—but not a must
  • You’re highly organized and thrive managing multiple projects, stakeholders, and deadlines
  • You’re a strong communicator who can clearly express ideas and influence different audiences
  • You’re proactive, solutions-oriented, and comfortable navigating ambiguity
  • You enjoy working collaboratively in cross-functional environments
  • Familiarity with privacy management tools (e.g., OneTrust, TrustArc)

• Health insurance for the whole family, flexible working environment and well-being support and tools
  • Extra days off, sabbatical program and days for you to give back for the community
  • Training opportunities and free access to Udemy
  • Flexible benefits program

descriptionPlain:
FARFETCH exists for the love of fashion. Our mission is to be the global platform for luxury fashion, connecting creators, curators, and consumers.
We're a positive platform for good, bringing together an incredible creative community made up of our people, our partners, and our customers. This community is at the heart of our business success. We welcome differences, empower individuality and celebrate diverse skills and perspectives, creating an inclusive environment for everyone. We are FARFETCH for All.
 
OPERATIONS
We're passionate about operational excellence, acting with our customers and partners always in our hearts. Covering the entire order journey, we create our online content, secure payments and fraud process compliance, and ensure order fulfillment and delivery, while providing customer and partner care. In a nutshell, we love to create seamless and memorable luxury experiences for our customers all around the world.
 
PORTO
Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals.
 
THE ROLE
We are looking for a “B2B Operations Specialist” to optimize and scale the Farfetch partner ecosystem. In this role, you will own the operational health of our B2B relationships by leveraging data, automation, and AI-driven insights to predict friction points before they happen.
You will be part of a fast-paced B2B team that thrives on transforming complex operational challenges into streamlined, scalable processes for the world’s best luxury boutiques and brands.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a “B2B Operations Specialist” to optimize and scale the Farfetch partner ecosystem. In this role, you will own the operational health of our B2B relationships by leveraging data, automation, and AI-driven insights to predict friction points before they happen.

You will be part of a fast-paced B2B team that thrives on transforming complex operational challenges into streamlined, scalable processes for the world’s best luxury boutiques and brands.

lists.content:
• Partner Operational Support: Act as the primary point of contact for partners for day-to-day operational and technical queries (e.g. order and returns issues, system-related questions, and customer service priorities), delivering timely, high-quality support across all communication channels to ensure operational continuity and partner satisfaction. 

  • Data-Driven Problem Solving: Monitor and analyze partner operational KPIs to identify trends, diagnose systemic bottlenecks, and proactively engineer long-term solutions for recurring issues.

  • Technical Account Management: Act as the primary escalation point for complex technical and operational queries, translating technical friction into actionable product feedback.

  • AI & Automation Integration: Leverage AI tools and automated workflows to streamline routine partner queries, increasing self-service capabilities and freeing up your bandwidth for high-impact, strategic partner interventions.

  • Cross-Functional Process Engineering: Partner with the organization to champion the "voice of the partner," utilizing data trends to influence operational standards and drive value for the partner ecosystem.

  • Continuous Improvement: Define, document, and scale best-in-class operational frameworks that elevate partner autonomy, efficiency, and satisfaction.

• Analytical Mindset: You don't just look at data; you look through it to find root causes. You are comfortable using data visualization tools.

  • Tech and Automation Savvy: You have a natural curiosity for tech stacks, APIs, and AI tools. You look for ways to automate manual tasks rather than doing them repetitively.

  • B2B Operations Background: Experienced in a B2B, e-commerce operations, or technical account management environment where you managed complex enterprise or vendor relationships.

  • Problem Solver: You have a strategic approach to troubleshooting. When a process breaks, your instinct is to fix the system, not just the individual case.

  • Strong Communicator & Influencer: Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for both luxury brand partners and internal teams.

  • Agile and Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-paced environment and is comfortable navigating ambiguity as our platform and tools evolve.

descriptionBody:
Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry. The Farfetch Marketplace connects customers in over 190 countries and territories with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands, boutiques, and department stores, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace.
 
TECHNOLOGY
We're on a mission to build end-to-end products and technology that powers the an incredible e-commerce experience for luxury customers everywhere, understanding the motivations and needs of our customers and partners, to designing and testing hypotheses, to creating industry-leading experiences for luxury customers.
 
PORTO
Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals.
 
THE ROLE
Are you passionate about networking, cloud technologies, and automation? Do you approach infrastructure with a DevOps mindset? If so, we'd love to hear from you.
We're looking for a Cloud Network Engineer to join our Platform team and help design, automate, and operate secure, scalable, and resilient cloud network infrastructure. This is an exciting opportunity to work with modern cloud technologies, Infrastructure as Code, and network automation while contributing to solutions that have a real business impact.

lists.content:
• Drive Strategy & Insights: Lead the generation of high-level, action-driven insights. Present executive summaries to leadership to shape business strategy and proactively identify opportunities to optimize pricing and profitability on Farfetch.

  • Build Business Cases & Tools: Construct robust business cases, analytical frameworks, and tools that empower senior leadership to make sharper, data-backed commercial decisions.

  • Team Management & Development: Potential to manage direct reports and build a high-performing team, fostering a culture of operational excellence and continuous learning within the Commercial function.

  • Architect Solutions: Oversee the development of scalable tools, processes, and reporting frameworks (partnering with our BI and Product team) to continuously monitor our pricing position and mitigate risks across global markets.

  • Own End-to-End Projects: Direct and manage the full lifecycle of complex, cross-functional projects to improve our price position, securing buy-in and support from senior stakeholders across the business.

  • Senior Business Partnering: Act as the primary strategic partner and subject matter expert to a wide spectrum of key stakeholders, both in and out of the Commercial team.

  • Influence Partner Strategy: Guide the Brand Partnership, Business Development, and Account Management teams, providing them with the frameworks needed to successfully influence and optimize the pricing strategies of our boutique and brand partners.

  • Guide Merchandising & Finance: Collaborate with Merchandising to translate complex data into actionable trading decisions, and partner with Finance to validate forecasting models, ensuring business targets are met.

  • Product Development: Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to define and implement a robust feature roadmap that empowers our Partners to effectively manage their pricing on the platform.

• Experience: Experience in Strategy, Analytics, e-Commerce, or Consulting at manager level

  • Technically Proficient: You possess strong technical skills for processing and analyzing large datasets: Excel (advanced) and SQL (required), with the ability to translate complex data into clear executive narratives.

  • Strategic & Operational Thinker: You have a deeply strategic mindset combined with a relentless focus on operational and commercial excellence.

  • Proven Influencer: You have a track record of driving change, securing buy-in, and confidently partnering with senior leadership on investment-style decisions.

  • Effective Communicator: You possess excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of distilling complex commercial concepts for non-technical audiences.

  • Organized Leader: You demonstrate exceptional organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously.

  • (Desirable): An understanding of the fashion and luxury industry ecosystem

  • Flexible Benefits Program
  • Health Insurance & Critical Illness cover
  • Flexible work environment (3 days a week in office, 2 days WFH)

descriptionPlain:
Stadium Goods is the premier global platform for sneakers, streetwear, and collectibles, offering a curated selection of the most sought-after brands and releases. Founded in 2015, Stadium Goods has become a trusted destination for sneaker and streetwear enthusiasts, blending a seamless shopping experience with unparalleled product authenticity. With its headquarters in New York City and a strong digital presence, Stadium Goods connects consumers worldwide with rare and iconic pieces that define modern culture. 
 
THE ROLE
We are seeking an experienced consignment specialist to participate in our NY Consignment team operations and activities. The responsibilities include authentication and intake of merchandise, entering product information into our databases, and maintaining accurate records of valuable company information. Our ideal candidate has essential data entry skills, like fast typing, an eye for detail, and familiarity with spreadsheets and other inventory databases. You will work with the warehouse operations team, as well as with the Consignment Managers to meet our goals of increased efficiency, profitability, and customer satisfaction.

lists.content:
• You will receive incoming merchandise from consigners, customers, or other warehouses accurately and promptly.
  • You will examine products for authenticity, quality, etc., and process accordingly.
  • You will appropriately record and report any discrepancies.
  • You will enter data into an inventory control system, ensuring the accuracy of information.
  • You will mark information on incoming merchandise.
  • You will keep a clean and safe working environment and optimize space utilization.
  • You will follow quality service standards and comply with procedures, rules, and regulations.
  • You will work with managers and other team members to ensure a successful product lifecycle from beginning to end.
  • You will build and maintain working relationships with current and potential consignors

• You can confirm the authenticity of products coming into the SG environment
  • You have strong organizational and time management skills, with an ability to stay focused on assigned tasks
  • You are experienced with MS Office.
  • You are proficient in inventory software, databases, and systems
  • You can lift heavy objects (up to 50lbs.)
  • You have a team player attitude, willing to go above and beyond at all times

Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.
  • If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplac
 
OPERATIONS
The Operations team serves as the backbone of our marketplace, seamlessly managing the entire order journey. From creating online content and ensuring secure payments to order fulfillment and delivery, while providing comprehensive customer and partner care, this team is relentlessly focused on improving the customer experience every single day.
 
LISBON
The FARFETCH office located within the Sítio co-working space network in Lisbon is designed to be a highly flexible and well-connected hub. This is centrally-located workspace close to major business areas, and a vibrant spot.
 
THE ROLE
As a Customer Service Advisor, you are  the face and voice of Farfetch strategic partners and a key team member who loves and understands customers, keeping them front of mind. Exceeds their expectations by providing exceptional service through the quality, speed and efficiency of your support and delivering an unforgettable experience while helping them discover our partner’s amazing products selection. Reporting to the Customer Service Supervisor, you will gain excellent hands-on experience in a fast-paced fashion environment.

lists.content:
• Be the first point of contact, providing an optimum level of service to all of our customers, resolving their queries and requests across multiple channels (email, phone, and chat) within our customer promise;
  • Provide information and best advisory with regards to products and services and other related inquiries;
  • Take ownership of case resolution, finding the best solutions according to the company’s process and guidelines;
  • Manage demanding customers with professionalism and emotional intelligence focusing on solution and retention;
  • Advocate on your customer's needs working with other internal teams, namely by identifying and boosting localization initiatives;
  • Managing your own development and supporting others to maximize team potential;
  • Actively contribute to a great work environment and the alignment with Farfetch and strategic partners' values in the team.

• Experienced in customer service (minimum of 1 year), preferably in a fashion and/or e-commerce environment;
  • Someone with excellent English proficiency in written and spoken form;
  • Someone with good IT skills (both customer service specific and windows packages) that enjoys guiding our customers when navigating our digital platforms.
  • A person with excellent communication skills, with the ability and confidence to resolve complex customer issues with a positive approach
  • Someone with natural multi-tasking ability, with an excellent eye for detail, critical thinking and good organizational skills
  • Passionate and knowledgeable of sports and sportswear is a plus
  • Self-driven person, but also a strong team player
  • Available to work on late shifts

• Training opportunities.
  • Flexible benefits program

• Farfetch is an equal opportunities employer ensuring that all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process. 
  • We are determined that no applicant experiences discrimination on the basis of sex, race, ethnicity, religion or belief, disability, age, gender identity, ancestry, sexual orientation, veteran status, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

• It has come to our attention that there may be fraudulent activities involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent Farfetch in order to attract candidates to a SCAM. Please be aware that Farfetch does not conduct recruitment processes through messaging apps or any unofficial communication channels, other than our official careers website. Additionally, Farfetch will never ask candidates for any form of payment during the recruitment process.

descriptionPlain:
Farfetch exists for the love of fashion. We believe in empowering individuality. Our mission is to be the global platform for luxury fashion, connecting creators, curators and consumers.
 
We're a diverse and global community made up of Farfetchers, our partners and our customers, which we believe is at the heart of our success. Everything we do is centred around our values - Be Human, Think Global, Be Revolutionary, Todos Juntos, Be Brilliant, Amaze Customers - which define our beliefs and our actions. We welcome difference and foster a consciously inclusive environment for everyone. We are Farfetch For All.
 
Operations 
We're passionate about operational excellence, acting with our customers always in our heart. From Content Creation, to Payments and Fraud, to Delivery and Customer Care Services, we're creating seamless and luxury experiences for our customers all around the world.

lists.content: • As a Customer Service Advisor you have a vital role in the Customer Service Department, where you are responsible for mentoring, reporting to supervisors, as well as solving customer inquiries and problems and improving strategies and procedures.

• Provide subject matter expertise and interpretation of procedures to less experienced Customer Service Representatives and provide direction to meet defined productivity and performance goals;
  • Conduct extensive research to resolve complex customer problems and assist managers and supervisors in handling escalated inquiries or complaints;
  • Provide feedback and present ideas for improving or implementing processes and tools with an overall customer service impact;
  • Interact with immediate team and communicate with other departments
  • Interpersonal verbal communication skills that build rapport and trust, deliver information in an easy to understand manner, and clearly articulate why a solution is the best course of action;
  • Interpersonal written communication skills to accurately document activity in proper business writing
  • Ability to breakdown complex problems into sequential priorities and then select solutions to resolve the entire problem (Analytical, critical and design thinking)
  • Seeks opportunities to improve depth/breadth of knowledge and personal performance (Desire to learn)

• You have good interpersonal and soft skills;
  • You have excellent communication skills, both verbal and written;
  • You have the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment;
  • You have good conflict resolution skills;
  • You have a critical mindset and good sense of judgement;
  • You have Knowledge about internal procedures and business model;
  • Excellent in listening;
  • Be attentive to Detail;
  • Able to prioritise tasks wisely
  • Time Management;
  • Available to work on rotating shifts;
  • Able to exceed customer expectations.

LISBON
Our Lisbon office provides a dynamic workspace, surrounded by the city's top cafés, restaurants, and stunning riverfront views. It seamlessly blends innovation with the capital's cosmopolitan and creative energy.
 
THE ROLE
We are looking for a Customer Service Advisor (French Speaker), to work in a very and relaxed environment and be part of a well-motivated, and growing team. Reporting to the Customer Service Supervisor, you will gain excellent experience, which will broaden as the team grows. You will have main responsibility to ensure that the highest levels of customer service are delivered to both our consumers and partners and through every communication channel.

FINANCE
The Finance team stands as a strategic pillar of our organization, enabling the delivery of our business and financial goals, ensuring robust financial controls and optimizing overall financial performance. Finance is responsible for managing capital, ensuring financial integrity, optimizing resource allocation, and delivering accurate reporting to drive sustainable growth and profitability.
 
PORTO
Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals. 
 
THE ROLE
 As Finance Application Specialist, you will support the implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement of the company’s financial reporting, planning and consolidation systems. You will be involved in the end-to-end lifecycle of system projects, from design and development to deployment, ensuring data integrity, process optimization, and alignment across global financial modules. Acting as a link between business and technical teams, you will help troubleshoot system issues, manage configurations, and contribute to the delivery of accurate, efficient, and reliable financial data solutions. 
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO 
Support on the implementation of new projects cooperating on all different phases of a project, design, develop and deploy
Ensure and maintain data integrity and alignment between the global financial planning and consolidation modules (configuration, test, reconciliation, production vs. quality)
Maintenance and administration of SAP BPC, specifically: Dimensions and Models, Teams and Task Profiles, Data Access Profiles and Work Status
Interface with technical teams, business and support partner to resolve issues
Manage incident, problem, and change management tracking processes
Identify, manage and resolve common system issues
Identify system processes to optimize, re-design and implement new changes in the system
Train End Users as needed on system processes
 
WHO YOU ARE
Degree in IT, Business OR similar
Previous experience of HFM and/or Hyperion Essbase/Planning or SAP BPC would be an advantage
Experience in document processes and procedures
Commitment to quality and excellent customer service to end users
Capable of successfully multi-tasking while working independently or within a group environment
Capable of working well under pressure while dealing with unexpected problems in a professional manner
Strong analytical thinking and problem solving skills
Fluent in English, both written and spoken is mandatory 
 
REWARDS & BENEFITS
Employee Pension Scheme
Flexible Benefits Program
Health Insurance & Critical Illness cover
Flexible work environment- Hybrid Model (3 days a week from the office, 2 days from home)
 
EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES STATEMENT

If you require special accommodation, please let us know.

lists.content:
• Analyse, create and/or edit information of the items that arrive production accordingly to our guidelines;
  • Identify similar products across multiple sources;
  • Verify and validate product information to ensure accuracy and completeness by cross-referencing across multiple sources;
  • Compare product information to determine if items are the same or different, identifying variations in attributes such as name, description, and other specifications;
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies found during the validation process, documenting issues and communicating findings effectively to relevant stakeholders;
  • Use the internal platform to register and monitor data quality;
  • Analyse product defects and identify actions required to resolve them.

• 1+ years of experience in e-commerce, sales or related field a plus;
  • Intermediate Excel skills;
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to spot patterns, anomalies, and inconsistencies;
  • Ability to prioritise and multi-task without compromising on quality standards;
  • Abstraction, ability to learn new things and work with new tools;
  • Advanced IT and English skills.

lists.content:
• You will develop the Farfetch Private Client base (a portfolio of 150+ top clients) by nurturing existing clients, reactivating lapsed clients, and developing personal relationships with new, high-value prospects to introduce them to the Farfetch Private Client service.
  • You will confidently segment your client book to achieve maximum impact in personalising the client experience and optimise engagement based on individual preferences and shopping behaviour. 
  • You will champion customer service and always exceed clients expectations and maintain client relationships to the standards required to enable achievement of personal sales targets and related KPI’s. 
  • You will develop an awareness of the company strategy and stay aware of the company organisational objectives and consider this when defining personal objectives and goals.
  • Work closely with the Private Client Manager to analyse data on weekly and monthly reporting whilst providing comprehensive feedback on assigned contributing projects and regional information. 
  • You will develop an understanding of key tools including Looker and Salesforce and use these to analyse data to identify key trends and focus areas to drive sales with your client book and make decisions to help drive your overall business performance. 
  • Using a range of data and creative tools, you’ll build personalised and inspiring assets for your clients, to inform them of new products, designers and other Farfetch news that is relevant to their interests.
  • You will think creatively to propose acquisitions events to co-host with Senior Stylists as well as attending external networking and social events.
  • You will share knowledge on products, brands, and trends with your clients and the team.

• You’ll have proven experience in fashion sales (luxury preferable), with a track record of exceeding sales targets with the drive and motivation to sustain this. 
  • You’ll have deep knowledge of current, international fashion trends, designers and products, and a passion for styling and storytelling. 
  • You’ll have the ability to approach situations and make decisions that are commercially driven, understanding what drives business success and the factors that influence that success.
  • You’ll have an existing strong client book consisting of a majority client base situated in North America.
  • You are an active listener and can create a positive working environment through speaking and creating empathy with clients and colleagues.
  • Proven ability to to negotiate, engage & build customer relations (clienteling)
  • Strong computer literacy and proficiency in using Microsoft Excel and Powerpoint Presentation.
  • An excellent team player but also able to work on own initiative
  • Excellent organisational skills and able to meet deadlines
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, adopting a flexible approach.

• The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $60,000 and $70,000 a year; however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.
  • If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

COMMERCIAL
We're partnering with global brands and the most influential and renowned boutique curators to bring our customers an unrivalled range of fashion to empower their individuality. We’re relationship builders, we’re solution finders and we’re analysts. We work with all areas of the FARFETCH business to improve our social and environmental impact while delivering business success. We want to empower our consumers to buy better, improve our operational footprint, and explore new business models that improve our impact.
 
LONDON
Our office is located in Old Street, London's tech hub. Our open-plan space is ideal for collaborative working. When you're not doing what's never been done, you can enjoy a team lunch on our large outdoor terrace, or join a yoga class in our dedicated studio.
 
THE ROLE
The Head of Business Development is responsible for leading business development across Brands and Boutiques for the EMEA region, with dotted line accountability from Americas and APAC regions. The Head of BD will own the pipeline of brand and boutique signings and be responsible for setting targets and driving the team to deliver against new business opportunities. Concurrently, the Head of BD will also oversee expansions and terminations within the existing partner portfolio. 
 
The role will require thought leadership on new commercial & operational models that best fit partner needs and reflect changes in the competitive landscape; a strong and detailed grasp on the specifics of FARFETCH’s legal and financial setup; and close collaboration with Integrations (PI) on partner technical needs, and Merchandising on pipeline prioritisation. Finally, the Head of BD should also oversee the transition from new partner signing into ongoing partner management once handed over to Brand Management, Account Management, and Partner Success/Service teams.

  • You will own the EMEA Brand and Boutique pipeline, set quarterly targets (against which compensation/bonus targets are set) and deliver against them; within the total pipeline you will also have your own target accounts to sign
  • You will liaise with Americas and APAC BD to ensure consistency in ways-of-working and targets’ alignment
  • You will oversee all compliance and SOX topics managed by team analyst
  • You will lead on the oversight and execution of commercial deals brought by Account Managers, working with Commercial Analytics and Finance to push forward productive deals that unlock stock for FARFETCH to offset any Gross Profit erosion
  • You will own the “BD Challenge” across cross-Commercial teams, outsourcing upper-funnel
  • Lead validation to Brand Management and Account Management for handover of warm Leads to BD for signing
  • You will own the roll-out of the Bid-Ask commercial model, including regional expansion
  • You will support on the expansion of the Sold By FARFETCH programme to markets where it is not yet available 
  • You will support Partner Implementation with their “5 minutes to online” programme, communicating partner needs and sharing external best-practices with internal teams to help FARFETCH develop an industry-leading launch toolkit
  • You will be a senior representative of FAREFTCH in new business acquisition, ensuring top-notch output and presentation reflective of FAREFTCH’s luxury positioning
  • You will be the lead contact for EMEA Brands & Boutiques BD topics, responsible for escalation to Executive level

• You are a skilled and convincing salesperson with the ability to explain the FAFFETCH value proposition in a compelling and purposeful way
  • You are an excellent negotiator
  • You have deep-rooted knowledge of the 3rd-party supply landscape in EMEA and 3rd party marketplace integrators 
  • You are meticulous and detail-oriented
  • You have excellent planning and analytical skills
  • You are good at prioritising, at story-lining, and at drawing out insights from data
  • You are a driven and compassionate team leader
  • You have a good understanding and interest of the wider fashion industry, largely luxury brands and key retailers, and are passionate about fashion

Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry, connecting customers in over 190 countries with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands and charming boutiques from around the world. Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. 
 

FINANCE

The Finance team stands as a strategic pillar of our organization, enabling the delivery of our business and financial goals, ensuring robust financial controls and optimizing overall financial performance. Finance is responsible for managing capital, ensuring financial integrity, optimizing resource allocation, and delivering accurate reporting to drive sustainable growth and profitability.
 

PORTO

Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals. 
 

THE ROLE

A great opportunity to be part of the Farfetch family and get a new view on Indirect tax affairs and its impact in a Group with worldwide presence.

Reporting to the Senior VAT Manager, you will work together with the wider team in supporting the overall FARFETCH Group on all VAT matters. 

This is indeed a great opportunity to work in-house and experience first-hand what it is like to work VAT from a business perspective and without any country boundaries, as you will be working with multiple locations.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Assist with day-to-day advisory support to the Group regarding VAT issues and questions

  • Support your management with the monitoring of our tax technology solutions (already implemented) within the Group as well as VAT updates and new regulations

  • Support the wider team in integration of new business lines, transactions and projects / procedures within the Group. You will be actively supporting in the design of solutions and / or improvements proposals and respective implementations

  • Actively track and monitor relevant indirect tax legislation to ensure overall compliance and awareness within the Group

  • Monitor indirect tax workflows and keep tax related documentation updated

  • Work with the wider Indirect Tax team (including our internal compliance & Reporting team) in any Indirect Tax workstreams

  • When necessary, you will liaise with external advisors where appropriate to provide tax advice and planning for the business, as required

 

WHO YOU ARE

  • Indirect Tax consultant with minimum of 2-3 years of experience

  • Experience in EU VAT required

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken)

  • High sense of responsibility and autonomy are a requirement

  • Previous experience in e-commerce and / or fashion industry is an advantage

  • Good communication skills and ability to interact with different types of backgrounds as our team has direct contact with several departments, ranging from Tech to Product and Finance areas

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to respond under stress and adapt to our fast pace and daily changing reality

 

REWARDS & BENEFITS

  • Employee Pension Scheme
  • Flexible Benefits Program
  • Health Insurance & Critical Illness cover
  • Flexible work environment- Hybrid Model (3 days a week from the office, 2 days from home)
 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES STATEMENT

  • FARFETCH is committed to being an inclusive workplace where diversity in all its forms is celebrated. We make employment decisions without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, marital status, medical condition as defined by state law, physical or mental disability, military service or veteran status, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, genetic information or any other classification protected by applicable federal, state or local laws or ordinances. If you require special accommodation, please let us know.

descriptionPlain:
BROWNS FASHION
Disruptive, unexpected and revolutionary in our own way... Browns changed the course of retail and fashion history forever when it opened in 1970. Born in London but celebrated globally, we're the one-stop shop for the best luxury fashion including established designers and emerging talent; renowned for our influence in fashion and style, and our innovative approach to retail and high-level service. Powered by Farfetch, we continue to disrupt the retail landscape to deliver a global luxury shopping experience of the future, championing creativity and originality.
Our people are at the heart of everything we do. Together we are here to make a difference and to spread kindness. We welcome differences, empower individuality and celebrate diverse skills and perspectives, creating an inclusive environment for everyone.
 
MERCHANDISING
We support Browns to maximise commercial opportunities through effective management of Browns inventory, driving sales and profit through improved trading and planning, and we do this by supporting all channels across our store, brownsfashion.com and Farfetch. 
 
LONDON
Our London Head Office is based on Old Street, London's tech hub; our open plan space is ideal for collaborative working and sharing ideals. We also have a large outdoor terrace which is the perfect spot to have a team lunch or host an event. We also have a home in the form of our retail boutique at Browns Brook Street in Mayfair.
 
THE ROLE
The Interim Merchandiser will be responsible for delivering revenue, intake and sell through targets for their department, across all channels, in-line with the Browns vision. You will be able to join us on a 12 month fixed term contract, ideally able to start as soon as possible.

lists.content:
• Strategy & OTB Management: Partner closely with the Buying team to build and execute annual
    strategies and Open-to-Buy (OTB) budgets in line with Browns' KPIs. Proactively manage and trade
    OTB in-season to maximize commercial opportunities and mitigate risks

  • In-Season Trading: Analyse weekly departmental performance and leverage key trading levers to
    drive revenue. Lead the reorder process to ensure 100% availability of key styles.

  • Inventory & Intake Control: Strategically manage intake and stock flow to ensure we hit revenue and stock turn targets, ensuring a stellar assortment in our boutiques.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work collaboratively with other functions to drive multi-channel
    revenue, specifically partnering with Farfetch to optimize the Browns product offering on their
    platform.

  • Markdown Management: Own the end-of-season markdown process for your department, working
    closely with wider teams to clear stock efficiently while protecting profit margins.

  • Process Improvement & Upskilling: Act as the voice of merchandising on ad-hoc projects to optimize the product lifecycle, and play an active role in training and upskilling the wider merchandising team

• Background: Proven experience operating at a Merchandiser or Junior Merchandiser level, ideally
    within a luxury, premium, or fast-paced multi-brand fashion retail environment

  • WSSI Management: Deep, hands-on experience managing a WSSI (Weekly Stock & Sales Intake) to
    accurately forecast sales, stock levels, markdown impact, and margin.

  • Advanced Excel: Advanced proficiency in MS Excel (including complex formulas, pivot tables, and data modelling) is essential for daily analysis

  • Highly Driven & Autonomous: You are self-motivated, take true ownership of your department, andthrive when given the freedom to execute.

  •  Commercial & Analytical: You are a commercial thinker with exceptional analytical capabilities and sound business judgment.

  •  Action-Oriented: Highly proactive, accountable, and focused on finding solutions in a fast-paced
    environment.

  • Collaborative Communicator: You possess strong stakeholder management and influencing skills,
    with the ability to communicate with clarity.

  • Organised: Able to prioritize seamlessly and stay structured amidst shifting priorities

descriptionPlain:
Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry, connecting customers in over 190 countries with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands and charming boutiques from around the world. Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. 
ROLE OVERVIEW
We are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded Junior Procurement Sourcing Specialist to join our Strategic Sourcing team. In this role, you will play a hands-on part in selecting, evaluating, and negotiating with suppliers across our Supply Chain categories (such as third-party logistics (3PL), freight/transportation, warehousing, and packaging).
You will support Category Managers by conducting market research, managing the competitive bidding process, and analyzing supplier proposals to help us secure the best total cost of ownership (TCO) while ensuring supply chain resilience.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
RFx Management Support: Lead the preparation, distribution, and coordination of Requests for Proposal (RFP) for non-critical supply chain categories, with the support of your manager.
Commercial & Bid Analysis: Build comparative bid models (clean sheets) to analyze supplier pricing structures, evaluate proposals side-by-side, and identify hidden cost drivers.
Supplier Market Intelligence: Conduct proactive market research and benchmarking studies to stay ahead of industry trends, capacity constraints, fuel surcharges, and macroeconomic shifts impacting supply chain categories.
Negotiation Preparation: Assist Category Managers in preparing negotiation strategies by compiling historical spend data, performance metrics, and market price baselines.
Contracting Support: Coordinate with legal and compliance teams to assist in the drafting, reviewing, and execution of supplier agreements, Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), and Master Service Agreements (MSAs).
Supplier Onboarding & Qualification: Shepherd newly sourced vendors through the internal onboarding, risk assessment, and compliance approval processes.
Internal Stakeholder Management: Engage with key internal clients within the Supply Chain area, build strong relationship and support their business and procurement needs
Finance Integration: Work with Financial Planning & Analysis to support budget processes (including savings execution) and with Accounts Payable to support correct invoice processing
 
WHO YOU ARE
BA/BS degree in Supply Chain Management, Economics, Business, Engineering, or a related field
Fluent in English
1-5 years of experience in procurement, sourcing, or commercial/operational supply chain roles
Advanced Analysis skills (ability to manipulate large datasets, build cost comparison templates, and use lookup/index-match formulas)  
Basic Finance knowledge and awareness of generic business processes (Finance, HR, Commercial, Purchasing, Sales, Legal)
Negotiation and Project Management skills are a strong advantage
Experience in working with multiple international stakeholders
Ability to work within strict deadlines
Experience with Coupa will be a plus
REWARDS & BENEFITS
Employee Pension Scheme
Flexible Benefits Program
Health Insurance & Critical Illness cover
Flexible work environment- Hybrid Model (3 days a week from the office, 2 days from home)
 
EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES STATEMENT

We are seeking an accomplished, results-driven commercial professional to step into the role of Luxury Resale B2B Senior Account Manager in Japan. This position is ideal for an experienced individual contributor who seamlessly combines strong commercial acumen with deep operational expertise.

In this senior role, you will take full ownership of the long-term containment, operational performance, and B2B account retention strategies for our upfront buying and physical consignment partnerships. While your days will inevitably involve a degree of tactical, hands-on operational firefighting to keep processes moving smoothly, your primary focus must remain on driving mid-term framework optimization, establishing repeatable account playbooks, and conducting robust and data-driven reviews of partner performance. Furthermore, you will actively spearhead cross-functional continuous improvement projects alongside global teams. Reporting directly to the Luxury Resale Partnerships Senior Manager, you will serve as a key commercial pillar to scale our local B2B channels securely.

1. Mid-Term Framework Optimization & Performance Analytics

  • Establish, optimize, and execute structured, repeatable B2B account playbooks to ensure frictionless onboarding for incoming partners passed down by the New Business Development team.

  • Monitor and enhance partner operational efficiency, evaluating structured performance metrics and recommending data-driven process improvements.

  • Conduct regular business reviews with active upfront buying and physical consignment suppliers to advise them on optimizing stock mix, refresh frequencies, and overall partnership health.

    • 2. Cross-Functional Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as the core B2B partnership stakeholder in complex, cross-functional business initiatives alongside central global teams (Buying, Operations, Finance, Tech).

  • Translate macro-industry performance insights into regional growth strategies, unblocking systemic friction before it affects stock inflows or margins.

  • Provide structured feedback on partners' processes and needs to help internal teams develop scalable solutions for long-term B2B relationship success.

    • 3. Operational Shielding & Escalation Management

  • Act as the final line of defense for partner retention by directly resolving advanced daily or weekly operational struggles.

  • Support financial reconciliation bottlenecks, handling disputed credit notes or billing blocks with central Finance team.

• Experienced B2B Leader: You possess a minimum of 6 years of commercial experience in strategic B2B account management, corporate partnerships, or marketplace operations. Experience within a retail, brand, or wholesale fashion/luxury environment is highly advantageous.

  • Relationship Focused: You are highly skilled at building and managing relationships with key partners across different execution levels—from operational personnel to C-suite executives—as well as driving alignment across diverse internal teams.

  • Commercially & Analytically Minded: You possess a strong commercial mindset, translating performance and industry insights into concrete growth strategies. You deeply understand revenue drivers, market trends, and competitive positioning within the luxury resale sector.

  • An Expert Negotiator: You excel at strategic commercial negotiation. You possess the ability to effectively plan, influence, and drive complex discussions to secure long-term, highly profitable, and mutually beneficial agreements.

  • A Strategic Thinker: You are a proactive planner capable of high-level strategic thinking, linking abstract, long-range visions and multi-month operational roadmaps directly to daily execution.

  • Bilingual: You are fluent in Japanese and English, which is strictly required for high-stakes business negotiations, partner engagement, and seamless global collaboration.

• Flexible working environment and more!

  • Generous Annual Leave entitlement

We are seeking a high-caliber commercial leader to step into the role of Luxury Resale Partnerships Senior Manager in Japan. This role will shape the long-term vision, commercial strategy, and operational execution standards for our Japanese resale ecosystem. Moving beyond standalone execution, you will serve as the principal business lead for the region, driving a high-performing culture of partner-centricity and joint value creation.

As the strategic leader of the regional hub, you will directly manage and mentor a cross-functional regional hub—consisting of Business Development, Partner Success specialists, and the buying team—while aligning local market operations with global corporate objectives and ensuring flawless regional governance.

1. Resale Ecosystem Vision & Commercial Strategy

  • Define the long-term vision, commercial strategy, and development roadmap for the regional partner success and supply functions.

  • Act as the primary strategic advisor to the global Head Merchandise and executive leadership regarding market health, competitive positioning, and macro supply trends.

  • Architect, unlock, and manage high-stakes, C-level corporate relationships with leading Japanese luxury resale players and institutional suppliers to secure long-term volume pipeline growth.

  • Master high-level strategic negotiations and engineer complex commercial frameworks that protect corporate margins while ensuring mutually beneficial, scalable partnerships.

    • 2. Cross-Functional Hub Governance & People Management

  • Direct, mentor, and lead a high-performing local team, providing direct line management to Partner Success Specialists and B2B Business Development roles.

  • Translate executive company growth targets into structured, concrete regional workflows, facilitating seamless cross-functional execution between the local hub and central global teams (Buying, Operations, Finance, Tech).

  • Serve as the senior local representative for the corporate entity, managing strategic relationships with local tax consultants, financial auditors, and legal bodies.

• Experienced Leader: You possess a minimum of 8 years of commercial experience within a retail, brand, wholesale, or premium marketplace environment. Deep domain expertise in the luxury fashion or luxury resale sectors is highly advantageous.

  • Ecosystem Builder: You have a proven track record of designing, building, and scaling successful B2B partner programs from scratch, possessing the ability to influence C-suite stakeholders and shape regional channel strategies.

  • Strategic & Analytical Thinker: You excel at translating abstract, multi-year strategic visions into concrete, near-term operational roadmaps (6-18 month horizons) backed by data-driven insights.

  • Expert Negotiator: You are highly skilled at navigating high-stakes corporate negotiations, balancing commercial drive with the long-term health of partnerships.

  • Bilingual & Culturally Astute: You are fluent in Japanese (native-level preferred) and English. You possess complete mastery of Japanese corporate business etiquette (Ningengenkei) alongside the strong communication skills required to collaborate seamlessly across a global organization.

descriptionPlain:
Farfetch exists for the love of fashion. We believe in empowering individuality. Our mission is to be the global technology platform for luxury fashion, connecting creators, curators and consumers.We're a positive platform for good, bringing together an incredible creative community made up by our people, our partners and our customers. This community is at the heart of our business success. We welcome differences, empower individuality and celebrate diverse skills and perspectives, creating an inclusive environment for everyone. We are FARFETCH for All.
 
MARKETING
We’re a diverse team of Marketing professionals, spanning artistic and scientific expertise. We’re driven to amaze our global community of customers through our data-driven approach, revolutionary spirit, test and learn culture and collaborative style. All for the love of fashion.
 
LONDON OR PORTO
Our office is located in Old Street, London's tech hub while most of our engineering and product stakeholders are based out of Porto in Portugal. Our open-plan space in both locations is ideal for collaborative working. When you're not doing what's never been done, you can enjoy a team lunch on our large outdoor terrace, or join a yoga class in our dedicated studio in the London office. 
 
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly skilled Marketing Tech (Senior) Principal to join our dynamic team at Farfetch, reporting to our VP Growth Marketing. You will be responsible for leading the organization's efforts to lead the strategic development and optimization of marketing technology solutions to enhance channel performance, drive efficiency, and support ambitious business growth.

lists.content:
• Architect and oversee the integration of marketing technologies, ensuring seamless data flow across paid marketing channels (SEM, Paid Social, Display, Affiliates etc), web & app analytics, CRM and personalization platforms.

  • Partner with marketing, product, and engineering teams to define and implement scalable solutions that improve audience & value signals, attribution, and campaign performance.

  • Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations while maximizing the use of first-party data for personalization and performance optimization.

  • Define best practices, governance frameworks, and training programs to enhance marketing tech & AI adoption across teams.

  • Help Farfetch in driving towards a single customer view across all touchpoints and parts of the journey 

  • Work with marketing & product teams to optimise our product feeds with rich & accurate data for paid & organic channels

• Deep expertise in marketing technology platforms (e.g., CDPs, customer analytics tools, server-side tagging, customer engagement and automation platforms).

  • Ideally worked in an e-commerce environment with an understanding of online consumer behavior.

  • Strong technical background with experience in REST APIs, data architecture, and marketing automation workflows.

  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-friendly strategies that drive marketing performance.

  • Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts and strategies to senior management, resulting in measurable positive impacts on business operations and outcomes.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, product, data science, and engineering teams (eg managing RFPs with service providers).

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a data-driven mindset and a passion for innovation.

  • Extensive hands-on or leadership experience in Search Marketing or Display Marketing is a strong plus.

lists.content:
• Assist in the design and implementation of robust observability infrastructure, focusing on the scalability, high availability, and performance of our core telemetry platforms.

  • Support the management of data pipelines and storage, ensuring the reliable ingestion, processing, and querying of Logs, Metrics, and Traces using technologies like OpenTelemetry (OTEL), Fluentbit, and the Victoria ecosystem.

  • Help build self-service capabilities that empower engineering teams and FARFETCH Business Units to be autonomous in their analysis, detection, and investigation efforts.

  • Monitor and maintain the reliability and performance of our internal observability stack, ensuring systems like Grafana and various exporters remain robust.

  • Support the integration of Observability Frameworks (Audit, Logging, Monitoring, etc.), ensuring they fit seamlessly into the broader platform architecture.

  • Actively participate in technical discussions, learn from senior engineers, and share your knowledge to foster a culture of continuous learning and psychological safety within the team.

• You have practical experience (or a strong foundational understanding) building, supporting, or maintaining observability tools and distributed systems.

  • You have hands-on experience or familiarity with telemetry infrastructure tools such as OpenTelemetry, Fluentbit, Victoria Metrics/Logs, and Grafana.

  • You have exposure to cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes) and are eager to deepen your knowledge of observability architecture.

  • You understand the software development lifecycle and have experience with at least one programming language (e.g., Golang or Python) to help build tools, exporters, or automations.

  • You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in continuous system improvement, infrastructure as code, and automation.

  • You have good interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with your team and other engineering stakeholders.

  • You understand the importance of data security, compliance, and cost-efficiency as core pillars of a reliable observability platform.

lists.content:
• Purchase Order Management:
  • Assist Buyers in writing orders and loading them efficiently in the system;
  • Maintain a process to gather all Master Data for items, often dealing with suppliers;
  • Manage Order Confirmation with suppliers and track cancellations, price changes or amendments that need to be fed through for;
  • Buying review.
    •  
  • Deliveries tracking:

  • Identify and escalate any late delivery exceptions or deliveries at risk to Buying.
    •  
  • Exceptions Management / Query Management:
  • Support Warehouse team handling discrepancies at inbound (ex. Items not on original PO, differences in quantities, differences on master data, etc);

The Farfetch Marketplace connects customers in over 190 countries and territories with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands, boutiques, and department stores, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. 
 
OPERATIONS 
 
We're passionate about operational excellence, acting with our customers and partners always in our heart. Covering the entire order journey, we create our online content, secure payments and fraud process compliance, ensure order fulfilment and delivery, while providing customer and partner care. In a nutshell, we love to create seamless and memorable luxury experiences for our customers all around the world.
 
PORTO
 
Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals.
 
ROLE
 
We are looking for a highly motivated individual with exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail, and a passion for learning. In this role, you’ll play a key part in maximizing our online catalogue by identifying gaps, streamlining processes, and driving data-informed decisions. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure our catalogue is as comprehensive, accurate, and efficient as possible. 
 
This is a unique opportunity to have a direct impact on our growth by ensuring customers have access to as much of our catalogue online as possible. You’ll work in a dynamic environment with smart, collaborative colleagues and plenty of room to grow your skills and career.

lists.content:
• Design, develop, implement, and manage cloud-native infrastructure and tooling that empowers our development teams.

  • Contribute to building self-service capabilities, abstracting complex infrastructure layers, and promoting engineering autonomy.

  • Operate and maintain a wide range of infrastructure components, including Linux and Kubernetes-based systems, using automated processes and pipelines.

  • Contribute to our culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for increased scalability, cost efficiency, and reliability.

  • Collaborate closely with other engineering teams to understand their needs and provide solutions that accelerate their productivity.

• Graduated or higher in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or have equivalent practical experience.

  • A strong interest in designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting large-scale distributed systems.

  • Ability to develop using programming languages such as Python or Golang.

  • Familiar with the principles of the software development lifecycle and the concepts of infrastructure-as-code.

  • Familiar with CI/CD pipelines and comfortable working with related tools/technologies (e.g. Jenkins, Git, ArgoCD).

  • Hands-on experience with containerized environments and container orchestration technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.

  • A strong interest in one or more of the following domains:

    • Cloud Infrastructure: Provisioning and Configuration Management (e.g., Azure, Terraform, Saltstack)

    • Networking: Traffic Management, Load Balancing, CDN, and DNS (e.g., HAProxy, Kong, CloudFlare, Firewall)

    • Software Development Lifecycle: Automating builds, tests, and deployments (e.g., Jenkins, ArgoCD, Artifactory)

    • Have a security-first mindset and an interest in compliance achievement.

    • Proactive, creative, and a great team player.

    • Good written and verbal English communication skills.

• Health insurance for the whole family, flexible working environment and well-being support and tools
  • Extra days off, sabbatical program and days for you to give back for the community
  • Training opportunities
  • Flexible benefits program

• Farfetch is an equal opportunities employer ensuring that all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process. We are determined that no applicant experiences discrimination on the basis of sex, race, ethnicity, religion or belief, disability, age, gender identity, ancestry, sexual orientation, veteran status, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

LONDON

THE ROLE

The Principal, Financial Crime and Regulatory Compliance is a senior role responsible for building, scaling, and overseeing global programs that protect the company from regulatory, financial, and reputational risk. This role spans multiple high-impact domains including AML, Sanctions compliance, ESG reporting readiness, and additional cross-functional compliance obligations such as Product related compliances.

lists.content:
• Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Program

    • Design and lead AML frameworks across multiple jurisdictions, including Due Diligence, Transaction Monitoring, and Suspicious Transaction Reporting.

    • Establish consistent governance standards, documentation requirements, and operational controls to ensure regulatory alignment across markets.

    • Identify emerging AML risk typologies and direct the development of monitoring rules, analytic methods, and escalation criteria.

    • Sanctions Compliance Management

      • Lead global sanctions screening for new and existing partners/customers and ensure compliance with U.S., U.K., E.U., and other applicable sanctions regimes.

      • Oversee sanctions system configuration, alert review procedures, and escalation protocols to maintain screening accuracy and defensibility.

      • Provide guidance to business teams on sanctions implications for customers, products, and market expansion.

      • Regulatory and Product Compliance

        • Develop and enforce a robust compliance framework to ensure relevant controls are in place to comply with regional safety, labelling, and certification standards (e.g., CE, UKCA, or INFORM Act) across a multi-jurisdictional marketplace.

        • Collaborate with business and legal teams to define restricted-item policies and automated gatekeeping/blocking mechanisms for high-risk product groups.

        • Cross-Functional Compliance Support

          • Provide support across adjacent compliance domains including ESG reporting.

          • Support design and operation of monitoring mechanisms for fraud, seller abuse, or related risk indicators, coordinating with internal functions as needed.

• Experienced in progressive experience in Compliance, with strong exposure to AML, sanctions, or financial crime risk management and related compliance domains. Certifications like CAMS and CGSS is a plus.

  • Experienced in designing and scaling compliance programs across multiple jurisdictions and compliance areas.

  • Strong understanding of global regulatory frameworks related to AML, sanctions, and Product related compliances.

  • Familiarity with ESG and sustainability reporting; CSRD experience is a plus.

  • Proven ability to build intelligence-driven monitoring programs and high-quality control environments.

  • Skilled stakeholder manager with excellent communication and influence capabilities.

  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, evolving environments with complex global regulatory expectations.

  • Highly analytical, detail-oriented, and capable of driving cross-functional initiatives at senior levels.
