description:
Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry, connecting customers in over 190 countries with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands and charming boutiques from around the world. Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. 
 

PORTO

Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals. 
 

THE ROLE

Leads procurement teams across a portfolio of goods and services. Responsible for developing and executing global and in-country category and contract management strategies while driving team performance, programme delivery, and high-level stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

1. People Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and inspire a high-performing procurement team to achieve their full potential.
  • Drive personal development, talent retention, and robust succession planning.

2. Category & Contract Strategy

  • Develop macro-level global category strategies balancing cost, quality, service, and risk mitigation.
  • Identify and lead strategic workshops focused on sourcing, procurement-led change, and contract optimization.

3. Programme Delivery

  • Ensure effective governance, resource allocation, and timely execution of the category programme.
  • Maintain a balanced project pipeline aligned with overarching business objectives and financial plans.

4. Stakeholder Engagement

  • Act as the primary procurement partner for senior stakeholders (up to Board level).
  • Navigate and influence a complex, multi-cultural, international stakeholder environment.
  • Build trust, challenge status quo with credible insights, and align procurement vision with business ambitions.

WHO ARE YOU

  • Commercial Operator: Deep expertise in total cost of ownership (TCO) and financial modelling; skilled at leveraging market insights and streamlining processes to optimize project design, cost, and timelines.
  • Strategic Thinker: Analytical and creative problem-solver capable of turning data and market intelligence into innovative procurement solutions.
  • Master Influencer: Expert at navigating matrixed international organisations, building cross-functional rapport, and bringing stakeholders along on the procurement journey.
  • Exceptional Leader: Proven track record of managing international teams, cultivating morale, and coaching individuals toward continuous performance and growth.
  • Agile & Self-Aware: Dynamic, self-directed leader who thrives in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, embodies core organizational values, and actively drives their own development.

REWARDS & BENEFITS

  • Employee Pension Scheme
  • Flexible Benefits Program
  • Health Insurance & Critical Illness cover
  • Flexible work environment- Hybrid Model (3 days a week from the office, 2 days from home)
 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES STATEMENT

  • FARFETCH is committed to being an inclusive workplace where diversity in all its forms is celebrated. We make employment decisions without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, marital status, medical condition as defined by state law, physical or mental disability, military service or veteran status, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, genetic information or any other classification protected by applicable federal, state or local laws or ordinances. If you require special accommodation, please let us know.

 

SCAM DISCLAIMER

Please be aware that Farfetch does not conduct recruitment processes through messaging apps or any unofficial communication channels, other than our official careers website. Additionally, Farfetch will never ask candidates for any form of payment during the recruitment process.

description:
Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry, connecting customers in over 190 countries with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands and charming boutiques from around the world. Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. 

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking an analytical, detail-oriented Procurement Operations Specialist to join our Procurement team. In this role, you will provide critical operational and data support for our Supply Chain categories (including logistics, warehousing, packaging, and transportation). You will sit at the intersection of purchasing execution and data analysis, helping us maintain strong vendor relationships, optimize workflows, and ensure the seamless flow of goods and services.

This position is designed for a proactive individual looking to build a long-term career in global supply chain management and strategic sourcing.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Purchase Order (PO) Management: Support the Supply Chain requesters, validate and track purchase orders with high attention to detail, ensuring full alignment with internal requirements and policies.

  • Operational Support: Monitor order statuses, expedite critical shipments, and proactively flag potential supply or delivery bottlenecks to internal stakeholders.

  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Maintain procurement dashboards. Conduct price analyses and track spend to identify cost-saving opportunities or process inefficiencies within supply chain categories.

  • Vendor Coordination: Act as an operational point of contact for external logistics and supply chain vendors. Maintain and update vendor databases, track supplier Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and assist in resolving billing or delivery discrepancies.

  • Sourcing Support: Assist Category Managers in preparing Requests for Information (RFIs) and Requests for Proposals (RFPs), compiling market research, and assessing vendor quotes.

  • Compliance & System Maintenance: Ensure all purchasing activities adhere to internal governance and compliance policies. Keep our ERP/Procurement software accurate and up to date for all Supply Chain suppliers, items and contracts.

  • Supplier Onboarding & Qualification: Shepherd newly sourced vendors through the internal onboarding, risk assessment, and compliance approval processes.

  • Internal Stakeholder Management: Engage with key internal clients within the Supply Chain area, build strong relationship and support their business and procurement needs
  • Finance Integration: Work with Financial Planning & Analysis to support budget processes (including savings execution) and with Accounts Payable to support correct invoice processing

WHO YOU ARE

  • BA/BS degree in Supply Chain Management, Economics, Business, Engineering, or a related field
  • Fluent in English
  • 1-5 years of experience in procurement, sourcing, or commercial/operational supply chain roles
  • Analytical skills (comfortable working with numbers and uncovering trends in data spreadsheets)
  • Project Management skills are a strong advantage
  • Experience in working with multiple international stakeholders
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate with internal logistics teams and external global suppliers, including in English  
  • Ability to work within strict deadlines and to stay organized and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly  
  • Experience with Coupa will be a plus

REWARDS & BENEFITS

  • Employee Pension Scheme
  • Flexible Benefits Program
  • Health Insurance & Critical Illness cover
  • Flexible work environment- Hybrid Model (3 days a week from the office, 2 days from home)

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES STATEMENT

  • FARFETCH is committed to being an inclusive workplace where diversity in all its forms is celebrated. We make employment decisions without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, marital status, medical condition as defined by state law, physical or mental disability, military service or veteran status, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, genetic information or any other classification protected by applicable federal, state or local laws or ordinances. If you require special accommodation, please let us know.

SCAM DISCLAIMER

  • It has come to our attention that there may be fraudulent activities involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent Farfetch in order to attract candidates to a SCAM. Please be aware that Farfetch does not conduct recruitment processes through messaging apps or any unofficial communication channels, other than our official careers website. Additionally, Farfetch will never ask candidates for any form of payment during the recruitment process.

As the regional lead for our Detection, Analysis, and Response Team (DART) in Portugal, you will serve as the "special forces" commander for our security organization. You will lead a high-caliber team of incident responders, maintaining a calm and collected demeanor during high-pressure situations while thinking critically as both an attacker and a defender.
This position is uniquely based at the Farfetch office in Porto, where you will split your leadership and technical expertise between Coupang Corp and Farfetch. You are responsible for overseeing the detection and neutralization of credible threats, developing advanced detective capabilities, and fostering a culture of relentless problem-solving within the regional unit.

You will lead a high-caliber team of incident responders, maintaining a calm and collected demeanor during high-pressure situations while thinking critically as both an attacker and a defender.
This position is uniquely based at the Farfetch office in Porto, where you will split your leadership and technical expertise between Coupang Corp and Farfetch. You are responsible for overseeing the detection and neutralization of credible threats, developing advanced detective capabilities, and fostering a culture of relentless problem-solving within the regional unit.

lists.content:
• Act as the functional lead for the Porto DART unit, managing local team members and overseeing the day-to-day security response operations for the region.
  • Manage security response workflows and collaboration across both Coupang and Farfetch environments.
  • Lead and coordinate responses to complex security anomalies, intrusion attempts, and breaches; oversee root-cause analysis and comprehensive executive reporting.
  • Drive advanced threat-hunting initiatives across cloud, endpoint, and network environments to identify undetected threats.
  • Serve as the final escalation point for the SOC and provide expert guidance and technical mentorship to Senior engineers and analysts.
  • Continuously improve and standardize incident response policies, automated playbooks, and SOC operational processes.
  • Partner with global engineering and business leaders through clear, technical, and executive-level communication to neutralize threats and mitigate vulnerabilities.
  • Participate in and oversee the on-call rotation to ensure 24/7 response readiness for urgent security events.

• You have ~10 years experience in Information Security, with at least 7+ years specifically dedicated to Cyber Security Incident Response (CSIRT) or Digital Forensics.
  • Experienced in a lead or managerial role, preferably within a global or regional office structure.
  • A professional with advanced hands-on experience analyzing and securing events within AWS, Azure or other major Cloud environments.
  • An expert in host-based investigations (Windows/Linux) and analyzing logs from EDR, HIPS, DLP, and SaaS solutions.
  • You demonstrate mastery of querying SIEM solutions and analyzing high-volume "big data" logs to identify sophisticated patterns of compromise.
  • Able to lead the automation of response workflows using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
  • Knowledgeable of mitigating web-based security events using CDN solutions like Akamai or Cloudflare.
  • Graduate in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced industry credentials such as GCIH, GCFA, GNFA, CISSP, or OSCP.
  • Deep understanding of container security (Kubernetes, Docker) and network forensics (packet analysis).
  • Experience operating SIEM platforms and developing custom detection use cases.
  • Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Portuguese or Korean is a plus for regional and headquarters coordination.

• Health insurance for the whole family, flexible working environment and well-being support and tools

THE ROLE

As a Finance Business Partner, you will be a key contributor to financial transformation and support the company's growth and profitability objectives. Reporting to the Finance Business Partner Manager, you will work closely with the Finance team and cross-functional stakeholders, with strong exposure to the business, to support performance analysis, forecasting and decision-making. You will manage financial performance across the global marketplace, focusing on both financial performance and operational costs (e.g. customer compensation costs, reimbursements). The role requires strong analytical skills, a genuine interest in how the business operates, and the ability to connect financial, accounting, and operational perspectives.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Cost control and estimation: act as the Finance point of contact for topics such as customer reimbursements and compensation, managing accruals and ensuring costs are accurately reflected, working closely with Accounting and Operations teams to guarantee data accuracy and compliance with accounting standards

  • Data analysis and modeling: work extensively with Tech and Data teams to build and improve the granularity and accuracy of figures, and develop or adjust internal financial models, including reconciliation between Finance and Ops to ensure they are accurate and reliable

  • Operations initiatives portfolio monitoring: support and provide financial guidance on operations initiatives, including recurring reviews with Tech and Accounting and tracking the financial impact of cost optimization and operational improvement projects

  • Mid- and long-term planning: support forecasting and budgeting processes by collecting trends and initiatives and incorporate on forecasting models. Analyze deviations versus plan and provide actionable insights

  • Performance monitoring and communication: Develop reports and dashboards for regular performance discussions with senior leadership, providing recommendations (acting as a bridge between financial and operational perspectives by translating data into actionable insights)

WHO YOU ARE

  • Degree in Economics, Management, Accounting, or a related field with a strong analytical focus; 5+ years of experience in financial analysis, FP&A, business partnering, or audit

  • Strong cross-functional communication skills, able to work closely with operations and accounting teams and translate financial information into business-relevant insights

  • Analytical, detail-oriented, comfortable working with large datasets, identifying patterns, and proposing data-driven scenarios to apply to accruals and forecasting models

  • Proficiency in Office tools (especially Excel and PowerPoint) and experience with data modeling and visualization tools (SQL/BigQuery, Looker or similar)

  • Curious and proactive, interested in building and improving tools and processes, demonstrating critical thinking and a continuous improvement mindset

  • Fluency in English, written and spoken

lists.content:
• Be a Technical Reference: Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will drive architectural decisions for both backend services and frontend applications, establishing coding standards and best practices.
  • E2E Ownership: Own the definition, planning, execution, delivery, and monitoring of features in a production environment, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Be Product-Driven: Pair with Product Managers on discovery, refinement, estimation, and prioritisation of new features, translating business requirements into technical specs.
  • Architect Scalable Solutions: Design and implement robust applications and event-driven architectures using Azure Service Bus and Hangfire for background processing and asynchronous tasks.
  • Ensure Data Integrity: Manage and optimise database schemas, ensuring data consistency and query performance.
  • Collaborate on UX/UI: Engage closely with the Design Team, ensuring faithful implementation of our web strategy and contribute to the evolution and maintenance of our internal Design System, ensuring visual consistency and code reusability.
  • Champion Documentation: Create and maintain clear documentation for APIs, architecture diagrams, and system flows.
  • Master the Stack: .NET (C#), SQL/MySQL/PostgreSQL, Hangfire, Azure Service Bus, React/TypeScript, Azure, Terraform, CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines).

• Experienced: You have at least 7 years of experience building and deploying distributed systems and web applications.
  • Backend Specialist: You have deep proficiency in .NET (C#) and a solid grasp of Object-Oriented Programming and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Database Proficient: You are comfortable working with relational databases and know how to optimise them for scale.
  • Async & Background Processing: You have proven experience implementing background jobs (using Hangfire or similar) and event-driven architecture using message brokers (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc).
  • Frontend Capable: You are proficient with React and TypeScript, capable of building and maintaining functional and responsive UI components.

descriptionBody:
Luxclusif is a technology-driven global B2B platform founded in 2013 and part of Farfetch since 2021. Dedicated to redefining the luxury paradigm by offering premium pre-owned fashion to a global audience, Luxclusif has pioneered the global luxury resale market, with advanced data-driven solutions to facilitate the buying and selling of high-end pre-owned items. With operations spread across the globe and strategic warehouses in key locations, ensure a seamless supply of luxury goods, ensuring item curation, quality control, operations, logistics to technology integrations and sales, delivering an unmatched resale experience for brands, retailers, and end-customers.

THE TEAM
Our R&D team is responsible for designing, developing, and evolving the internal products that power our business. As a B2B company specialising in second-hand luxury items, we rely on technology to optimise every stage of our operations, from buying and inbound logistics to selling and post-sales support. We are a global team with members across Portugal, Brazil, and the Philippines.

PORTO
Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals.

THE ROLE
As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you will join our Porto hub to develop internal products that power our business areas. You will pair with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers to define, plan, execute and foster a culture of technical excellence.

description:
FARFETCH exists for the love of fashion. Our mission is to be the global platform for luxury fashion, connecting creators, curators and consumers.

We're a positive platform for good, bringing together an incredible creative community made up by our people, our partners and our customers. This community is at the heart of our business success. We welcome differences, empower individuality and celebrate diverse skills and perspectives, creating an inclusive environment for everyone. We are FARFETCH for All.

LONDON

Our office is located in Old Street, London's tech hub. Our open-plan space is ideal for collaborative working. When you're not doing what's never been done, you can enjoy a team lunch on our large outdoor terrace, or join a yoga class in our dedicated studio.

THE ROLE

We are looking for an ambitious Senior Sales Manager to join the FARFETCH Advertising team, starting as soon as possible (latest October).

Luxury brands leverage FARFETCH Advertising services to elevate brand awareness at every stage of the FARFETCH customer journey. Harnessing unparalleled consumer insights from the largest luxury online audience in the world; FARFETCH Advertising devise data-driven marketing strategies that power full-funnel marketing activations creating global impact at scale. We help brands maximize engagement amongst existing followers, prospect new customers and develop new audiences on FARFETCH and beyond. 

As Senior Sales Manager you will partner closely with a range of luxury clients (from SMB to enterprise accounts) to create exciting and innovative advertising partnerships that enhance the consumer experience, build brand equity and drive revenue growth for the FARFETCH business.

lists.content:
• Build and grow a pipeline of clients (both new and existing) with accountability for the entire sales cycle; from lead generation to closing deals and ensuring retention 

  • Leverage data, insights, and measurement to build innovative marketing communication plans that reach partner audience targets and achieve partner KPIs

  • Work closely with a dedicated Account Manager to streamline pre-sales efforts, identify optimisation/upsell opportunities and build long-term strategies for your accounts

  • Be an internal expert and advocate for your accounts, working cross-functionally to ensure marketing programmes complement the partner’s commercial objectives

  • Build deep relationships with senior brand executives through exceptional customer service

• Self-motivated and highly goal orientated with the ability to work autonomously, including cold prospecting where necessary

  • Strong contact network of decision makers in luxury fashion and retail

  • Significant experience in digital advertising, preferably with specific acumen in retail media, performance marketing and selling to enterprise accounts

  • Demonstrated track record of success in advertising sales; viewed as an expert in this field

  • Strong team player and ability to succeed in a fast moving, matrixed business while maintaining high levels of operational rigor, digital acumen, and business excellence

  • Bonus: ad tech or media agency experience, with strong knowledge of competitive product landscape

• Employee Pension Scheme 
  • Flexible Benefits Program 
  • Health Insurance & Critical Illness cover 
  • Flexible work environment- 3 days a week in the office, 2 days from home

As a vital member of our Detection, Analysis, and Response Team (DART) - the specialized Incident Response unit within our Security Response team - you will serve as the "special forces" of our security organization. In this role, you must maintain a calm, collected demeanor during high-pressure, time-sensitive situations while thinking critically as both an attacker and a defender. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze, respond to, and neutralize threats with precision and speed.
Security Response is responsible for responding to credible threats by developing advanced detective capabilities and identifying mitigations for complex vulnerabilities. Our DART Engineers are relentless problem-solvers who gather and analyze event data to conduct thorough root-cause analyses.

  • Conduct advanced threat hunting to identify undetected threats using data from endpoints, servers, cloud environments, and network traffic.

  • Continuously improve incident response policies, playbooks, and SOC operational processes.

  • communication.

The Farfetch Marketplace connects customers in over 190 countries and territories with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands, boutiques, and department stores, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace.
 
TECHNOLOGY
We're on a mission to build end-to-end products and technology that powers the an incredible e-commerce experience for luxury customers everywhere, understanding the motivations and needs of our customers and partners, to designing and testing hypotheses, to creating industry-leading experiences for luxury customers.
 
PORTO
Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals.
 
THE ROLE
As a vital member of our Detection, Analysis, and Response Team (DART) - the specialized Incident Response unit within our Security Response team - you will serve as the "special forces" of our security organization. In this role, you must maintain a calm, collected demeanor during high-pressure, time-sensitive situations while thinking critically as both an attacker and a defender. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze, respond to, and neutralize threats with precision and speed.
Security Response is responsible for responding to credible threats by developing advanced detective capabilities and identifying mitigations for complex vulnerabilities. Our DART Engineers are relentless problem-solvers who gather and analyze event data to conduct thorough root-cause analyses.
This position is based at the Farfetch office in Porto, Portugal. The successful candidate will split their time and responsibilities between Coupang Corp and Farfetch, providing high-level security expertise to both organizations.

descriptionPlain:
Established in 1970, Browns Fashion began with an iconic boutique at the heart of London. The brand was acquired by Farfetch in 2015, and today operates its flagship Browns Brook Street store, in Mayfair. and the online commerce www.brownsfashion.com
 THE ROLE 
The  position is based full-time in the Browns flagship boutique located on Brook Street, Mayfair.
Our stockroom team works collaboratively and seamlessly to fulfil the customer experience from start to finish, going above and beyond for both our store and customers, bringing our customer journey to life and supporting Browns on our mission to be the coolest multi-channel boutique in the world.

Working within the Customer Experience team, you will manage our inventory and ensure that our supply chain operates smoothly. In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring stock levels, tracking shipments, and maintaining accurate records of all incoming and outgoing merchandise.
The ideal candidate has a strong analytical mind, excellent organisational skills, and experience with inventory management software

Our stockroom team works collaboratively and seamlessly to fulfil the customer experience from start to finish, going above and beyond for both our store and customers, bringing our customer journey to life and supporting Browns on our mission to be the coolest multi-channel boutique in the world.

The ideal candidate has a strong analytical mind, excellent organisational skills, and experience with inventory management software

lists.content:
Inventory Auditing & Accuracy
  • Coordinate and complete stock audits to prevent and minimize the level of discrepancies.
  • Conduct regular physical inventory counts (cycle counts) and reconcile them with systemic records to identify discrepancies or shrinkage.
  • Investigate and correct stock variances across several branches.
  • Monitor stock levels daily to ensure they align with business needs and sales forecasts. 

    • Receiving & Order Processing

  • Oversee the receiving of deliveries, verify the quantity and quality of items, and log them into the inventory system.
  • Receive deliveries for shopfloor product and customer requests: check deliveries, process physical stock, update systems, put away all stock in the correct place, and communicate with relevant departments as required.
  • Manage returns of all old stock back to the warehouse according to agreed guidelines and set timeframes.

    • Stockroom Operations & Daily Management

  • Ensure the stockroom is organized efficiently, maintaining clear labels and safe storage practices.
  • Monitor the stock-flow between the distribution centre and the store.
  • Support the Stockroom Team in the delivery of administrative work, including running and replenishing online orders.

    • Process Improvement & Strategy

  • Monitor and improve existing processes across the business to maintain stock accuracy.
  • Implement new processes with the Stock Room team to reduce the number of issues.
  • Liaise with the Stockroom Manager to create action plans focused on avoiding stock loss.
  • Liaise with cross-functional teams to ensure all stock-related procedures are consistently followed.

    • Data Reporting & Query Resolution

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of inventory and generate weekly and monthly inventory reports for management.
  • Oversee time-efficient investigations for online order queries regarding missing stock.
    •

• Previous stockroom experience, preferably in a stock controller function. 
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel essential
  • Experience using software such as Storm, D365, Shopify (preferred)
  • Able to manage tasks independently but also work closely to support your team, building strong relationships across the boutique with all teams including Personal Shoppers and Loss Prevention. 
  • Collaborative, flexible and able to adapt to changing priorities, prioritising customers at all times. 
  • Accuracy and attention to detail is essential.
  • Able to communicate clearly in written and oral form.
  • Able to problem solve and multitask.

OPERATIONS

The Operations team serves as the backbone of our marketplace, seamlessly managing the entire order journey. From creating online content and ensuring secure payments to order fulfillment and delivery, while providing comprehensive customer and partner care, this team is relentlessly focused on improving the customer experience every single day.

 

LISBON

The FARFETCH office located within the Sítio co-working space network in Lisbon is designed to be a highly flexible and well-connected hub. This is centrally-located workspace close to major business areas, and a vibrant spot.

 

THE ROLE

As a Translator (Product Information) for Japanese, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring Farfetch’s product catalogue and all related materials resonate with local audiences. Reporting directly to the LangOps & Development team, your primary responsibility will be localising diverse content types with a strong focus on product information, including materials, compositions, and size & fit details. Additionally, you will manage translation workflows, translation memories, and terminology databases to ensure quality and consistency across all platforms. You will also contribute to the continuous improvement of Farfetch’s localisation processes, ensuring a seamless customer experience while maintaining our distinctive tone of voice.

lists.content:
• Translate and localise product information, including detailed descriptions of materials, fabric compositions, and size & fit elements, ensuring clarity and accuracy for local audiences;

  • Localise and adapt FARFETCH’s product catalogue and associated content, tailoring the language to meet the cultural nuances and preferences of the target audience;

  • Manage translation workflows, ensuring projects are delivered on time and meet the highest quality standards;

  • Manage and maintain translation memories and terminology databases, ensuring consistency across all translated materials and optimising reuse of existing translations;

  • Review and clean up outdated or inaccurate copy, ensuring the product catalogue remains up-to-date, accurate, and aligned with luxury fashion standards;

  • Participate in company-wide initiatives to improve and optimise translation processes, content quality, and workflows for the product catalogue;

  • Ensure consistency in language and tone of voice across all channels, including website content, product descriptions, marketing campaigns, emails, and social media;

  • Collaborate with the larger multilingual team to align on best practices for localisation and maintain high-quality standards;

  • Utilise and contribute to the development of cutting-edge localisation tools and technology to streamline processes and improve accuracy;

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance the quality and efficiency of the translation process.

• Language Expert: Native-level fluency in Japanese, with exceptional written and verbal skills;

  • Luxury E-commerce Experience: Proven experience in writing, translating, and localising content for luxury or high-end e-commerce brands. Experience in translating technical product details such as fabric compositions, material properties, and size & fit elements is highly desired;

  • Cultural Sensitivity: Ability to craft compelling, customer-centric content that engages and appeals to the tastes and preferences of local audiences;

  • Process-Oriented: Experience in managing translation workflows, using translation memories, and maintaining terminology databases to ensure content consistency and quality;

  • Continuous Improvement Mindset: A proactive approach to improving the translation process, identifying outdated or inconsistent content, and actively participating in optimisation initiatives across departments;

LISBON

The FARFETCH office located within the Sítio co-working space network in Lisbon is designed to be a highly flexible and well-connected hub. This is centrally-located workspace close to major business areas, and a vibrant spot.

descriptionPlain:
Hello. We're Stadium Goods. We are the world's premier sneaker and streetwear marketplace selling only the most sought-after footwear, apparel and other hard-to-find items on behalf of our sellers. We are driven by our principles and committed to providing the best consumer and consignment experience there is. In January 2019, Stadium Goods became part of the Farfetch family of companies, which will help guide our evolution as we usher in the next chapter of growth.
 
 
THE ROLE
We are looking for Associate to support our General Warehouse Operations. You will manage the rate of inbound and outbound merchandise. You will also execute the process of returned merchandise.  You have proficient data entry skills and familiarity with spreadsheets. You will partner with the Warehouse Operations Manager and peers to meet our goals of increased efficiency, profitability and customer satisfaction.

descriptionPlain:
Stadium Goods is the premier global marketplace for authentic sneakers, streetwear, and collectibles. We sit at the intersection of retail, technology, and culture, empowering a massive community of buyers and sellers. Our digital ecosystem is the optimized interface that unlocks our core supply, driving sales across our flagship site, mobile app, and integrated global marketplaces.
 
We are a data-driven, fast-paced team that thrives on innovation and operational excellence. By mastering the full Shopify ecosystem—from the front-end user experience to the complex data flow connecting channels like Tapcart, TikTok, and Walmart—we ensure a seamless, world-class experience for our customers worldwide. Join us to own a critical piece of our technology stack and drive significant growth in a thriving, dynamic industry.
 
THE ROLE 
This role supports the end-to-end studio photography workflow by producing consistent, high-quality product imagery that meets brand standards. You’ll assist with lighting and studio setup, prepare merchandise for shooting, complete basic post-production tasks, and help maintain an organized, efficient studio environment. The position also requires meeting technical and stylistic quality expectations while sustaining strong productivity levels, ensuring smooth product flow and readiness for the responsibilities outlined in the bullets below.
